Package backend

Class Command

java.lang.Object
backend.Command
public class Command extends Object
Represents a command in the Scratch language. A command has a name, a list of arguments, and a list of child commands if it is a block command. For example, an "if" command has child commands that represent the commands inside the block.

  • Constructor Details

    • Command

      public Command(String name, ArrayList<String> args, int lineNumber)
      Creates a new Command with the given name, arguments, and line number. The isPrivate field is set to false by default because it refers to variable assignment.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the command
      args - arguments of command
      lineNumber - line number of original .scratch file

    • Command

      public Command(String name, ArrayList<String> args, int lineNumber, boolean isPrivate)
      Creates a new Command with the given name, arguments, line number, and isPrivate field. This constructor should only be used for variable assignment commands, which are the only commands that should have isPrivate set to true.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the command
      args - arguments of command
      lineNumber - line number of original .scratch file
      isPrivate - true if it is a variable declaration, false otherwise

    • Command

      Creates a new Command that is a deep copy of the given Command.

      other - other Command

    • replaceArg

      public void replaceArg(String oldArg, String newArg)
      Replaces the VALUE of an arg by name with a new value. Can replace the arg in an expression as well. This is used for variable assignment, where we want to replace all instances of a variable with its new value.
      Parameters:
      oldArg - the name of the argument to replace
      newArg - the new value for the argument

    • setArg

      public void setArg(int index, String newValue)
      Sets the argument at the given index to the new value. This is used for function argument replacement, where we want to replace the argument with the value passed in by the user.
      Parameters:
      index - the index of the argument to replace
      newValue - the new value for the argument

    • fullExpansion

      public ArrayList<Command> fullExpansion()
      Returns a list of all commands in this command's subtree, including itself. It is used for function argument replacement.
      Returns:
      all commands in the subtree rooted at this command

    • addChild

      public boolean addChild(Command child)
      Adds a child command to this command. This is only allowed if this command is a block command, which is determined by the LanguageConfig. If this command is not a block command, this method will print an error message and return false.
      Parameters:
      child - the child command to add
      Returns:
      boolean true if addChild worked. False otherwise. Only works if the command is deemed as a block type

    • addElseChild

      public boolean addElseChild(Command child)
      Adds an else child command to this command. This is only allowed if this command is a block command and is an "if" command, which is determined by the LanguageConfig. If this command is not an "if" block command, this method will print an error message and return false.
      Parameters:
      child - the child command to add as an else child
      Returns:
      boolean true if addElseChild worked. False otherwise. Only works if the command is deemed as an "if" block type
